candidates.vehicleIdentity: 2006 Audi TT quattro Sport | DU06FRC | 69,133 miles | £11,990 | Zachary Luke Cars
candidates.note: Fully reverified 22 Sep 2026. The exact Car & Classic advert is explicitly For Sale at £11,990 for a 2006 Audi TT quattro Sport, registration DU06FRC, 69,133 miles, manual, in Courteenhall, UK, and Zachary Luke Cars' current seller profile independently lists the same car among eight live listings at the same price. Nine accessible exact seller-gallery photographs were visually inspected; none shows SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER wording. The cabin photograph clearly shows a conventional manual gear lever and three pedals, consistent with the genuine six-speed manual quattro Sport. The existing feed entry remains eligible; no price change was found.
